identity.title: [v0.91.8][google-workspace][automation] Make ADL Drive context mirror work end to end

values.task_boundary: Correct transport selection, recursive traversal, exact readback verification, and success-only automation semantics.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: execute mode performs a real Drive create or update and exact readback verification
AC-2: docs and .adl/docs/TBD Markdown trees mirror recursively with preserved relative paths
AC-3: least-privilege scopes and explicit write approval remain enforced
AC-4: automation archives only fully verified successes and retains deduplicated failures
AC-5: fixture and focused tests prove deterministic success and fail-closed behavior
dependencies: Google Drive credentials and configured root folder
